decks.notes: This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly playing efficient threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Murktide Regent, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to pressure the opponent. The deck includes card draw and selection spells like Expressive Iteration and Consider to maintain momentum. Counterspells like Archmage's Charm and Counterspell are utilized to protect your creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat help deal with opposing threats. Mishra's Bauble provides card advantage and deck manipulation, while the mana base ensures consistent access to your colors.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing cards that can generate value over time, such as Wrenn and Six and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove. The deck aims to ramp up mana quickly with cards like Growth Spiral and Explore while disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Remand and Lightning Bolt. The win condition is to play Scapeshift and sacrifice lands to deal massive damage to the opponent with Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. The deck also includes cards like Expressive Iteration and Fire / Ice for card advantage and versatility.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana and using spells to control the board until you can cast a powerful creature like Archon of Cruelty. Utilize cards like Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat out big threats from your deck. Wrenn and Six provide value and recursion, while Leyline Binding can lock down opposing threats. Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can generate card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to surprise opponents with its unique combo elements and high-impact plays.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty into play early in the game. The deck also includes cards like Wrenn and Six and Jace, the Mind Sculptor to provide additional value and control options. The inclusion of cards like Hard Evidence and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker allow for card advantage and flexibility in dealing with different situations. The deck aims to be creative in its combos and interactions to catch opponents off-guard and secure a victory.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game early on with cards like Remand and Lightning Bolt while ramping up mana with cards like Arboreal Grazer and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove. The deck aims to get to its combo piece, Scapeshift, which allows the player to search for Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and a bunch of Mountains to deal a huge amount of damage to the opponent. Wrenn and Six helps to recycle lands and provide card advantage, making the deck more consistent. The goal is to outvalue the opponent and win with a big Scapeshift combo.

The deck focuses on cycling through the graveyard and disrupting the opponent's hand to set up for a powerful Living End combo. By cycling creatures like Street Wraith and Striped Riverwinder, the deck can quickly fill up the graveyard and then cast Living End to bring back a board full of creatures and overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive creatures like Grief to disrupt the opponent's hand and counter spells like Force of Negation to protect the combo. The deck aims to set up a big swing turn with Living End and win the game in a single explosive move.

The deck focuses on quickly equipping Colossus Hammer onto creatures like Ornithopter and Gingerbrute, using Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic to cheat out equipment and protect them with Giver of Runes. The deck aims to deal a large amount of damage in a single attack, thanks to the high power Colossus Hammer provides. The inclusion of Urza's Saga helps tutor for key artifacts, further enabling the combo to quickly assemble and execute. The deck relies on explosive turns to overwhelm the opponent before they can react effectively.

The deck focuses on playing powerful Eldrazi creatures and disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Chalice of the Void and Karn, the Great Creator. It aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with big creatures like Reality Smasher and Thought-Knot Seer while also having access to versatile removal options such as Dismember and Warping Wail. The deck also includes some utility lands like Eldrazi Temple and Urza's Saga to help ramp up and maintain board presence. Overall, the strategy is to apply pressure and control the game with Eldrazi creatures and disruptive spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing a toolbox of creatures to quickly assemble combos and disrupt opponents. It aims to efficiently tutor and play creatures like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician using cards like Eldritch Evolution and Chord of Calling. The deck also includes resilient creatures like Blood Artist and Geralf's Messenger for added value. The mana base is optimized to support the quick and smooth deployment of creatures, with a mix of lands that provide the necessary colors and acceleration.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on using efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, backed up by disruptive spells like Counterspell and Lightning Bolt. The deck also includes cantrips like Mishra's Bauble and Consider to dig for threats and answers while keeping the tempo high. The inclusion of Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ledger Shredder helps to fill the graveyard for Unholy Heat and Archmage's Charm. The manabase is optimized for consistency and allows for flexibility in casting spells with various color requirements.

This deck focuses on achieving a strong board presence through the use of efficient and aggressive Goblin creatures, such as Goblin Matron and Mogg War Marshal. It also incorporates combo potential with cards like Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker and Conspicuous Snoop to create explosive turns. The inclusion of Aether Vial allows for quick deployment of creatures, while cards like Munitions Expert provide removal options. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of Goblins while maintaining versatility and resiliency through its mana base and diverse creature options.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Cascade mechanic to cast Living End from the graveyard, allowing the player to return all creatures from both graveyards to the battlefield. The deck includes a variety of creatures with cycling abilities to quickly fill the graveyard, as well as disruption in the form of Force of Negation. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's board while building towards casting Living End to overwhelm them with a massive board presence in a single turn. The deck aims to win through a powerful combo finish.

The deck aims to quickly assemble a toolbox of creatures that can be tutored up for specific situations using Eldritch Evolution and Chord of Calling. Grist, the Hunger Tide and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician provide powerful sac outlets for generating value and disrupting the opponent's board. The combination of persist creatures like Geralf's Messenger and Blood Artist create a combo win condition, while Birds of Paradise and Ignoble Hierarch provide ramp and fixing. The deck is designed to be proactive and flexible, with the ability to adapt to different matchups and situations.

This aggressive Modern deck focuses on dealing direct damage to the opponent quickly with efficient creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, while also using burn spells like Lightning Bolt, Boros Charm, and Lava Spike to finish off the opponent. To further pressure the opponent, cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel and Searing Blaze punish opponents for casting spells or having creatures on the battlefield. The mana base includes fetch lands and pain lands to ensure consistent access to the deck's red spells.

The deck focuses on creating a powerful board presence through the use of Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat out big threats like Archon of Cruelty. Wrenn and Six provide recursion and card advantage, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker helps create a combo finish. The deck also includes a mix of versatile spells like Lightning Bolt, Prismari Command, and Spell Pierce for disruption and removal. The mana base is optimized for consistency and allows for easy access to a variety of colors for casting spells.

The deck focuses on quickly equipping Colossus Hammer to a creature, often Puresteel Paladin or Stoneforge Mystic, allowing for a powerful, fast combo. The inclusion of equipment like Kaldra Compleat and Shadowspear provides additional options for boosting the equipped creature's power and abilities. Teferi, Time Raveler and Esper Sentinel offer disruption and card advantage, while cards like Paradise Mantle and Springleaf Drum help ramp up the combo even faster. The lands are optimized for consistency and mana fixing, with Urza's Saga providing additional utility.
